meta.title: Pick a random open asset line that can be sourced

plan.title: Select an Open Asset PR Line

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area as the buyer.
Ensure the search is restricted to open requisitions that can be sourced.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions screen, find a random asset line that is fully open and sourceable; open its PR, verify Qty Open equals Qty Requested, confirm there is no lock or hold icon and no approval or dormant status, then record the PR number, line number, item, asset type, and the verified quantities; stop on the verified line.

steps.note: Perform the line-specific inspection and record the identifiers and eligibility evidence that no catalog assertion can target directly.
Confirm the final inspected PR screen has no visible error, crash, raw identifiers, or malformed values.
